clock.initial: before first player input; recorded as round0 with actual engine cursor retained
clock.ordinary: main phase0, after all round operations and before the next round increment
clock.last: exact final state, including a final partial round
clock.validated_against: native round-indexed RLE gold, gems, earnedGold, submissions and final metrics
clock.rejected_method: Timeline seek's third parameter is not a raw step.substep cursor; draft rounds also reuse the round field

sampling: every round <=300, every fifth later round, every native event round, and final
storage: local-only per-game JSON; schema and small calibration sample may be committed
events: exact native event time/owner/target/position; successful movement/cast/recall/bank/priority/teleport steps retain actual engine round/input/substep
perspective: both teams' true team-perspective state at retained round snapshots; exact actor-turn contexts are reconstructed separately for chosen cards
middle: minimum Chebyshev distance to initial spawn positions; neither side is <0.8 of the other distance
gold_sources: capture phase deltas; exact native kill/bank event pre/post credit deltas; all unmatched or mixed credits remain explicit residuals
equipment: actual current inventory purchase cost; standard emblem150, Greed emblem750, shard30; not combat power
time_categories: round-boundary proxies with declared precedence, not hidden modes or exact continuous durations
model: no terminal features, no future income, no game IDs/map/opponent labels as predictors; splits fixed in MODEL_SPLIT.json
